D&D Helper API — Codebase Guide\n\nThis is a small, deterministic HTTP API for D&D 5e style helpers.\nIt runs on OpenJDK with only the Java standard library and uses an external `sqlite3` binary for persistence.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles the Java sources under `dnd/` and runs `dnd.Main` in the foreground.\nThe server listens on `127.0.0.1` and honors the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`).\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n```\ndnd/\n  Main.java                 # entry point: opens the HTTP socket and wires the router\n  handlers/\n    RequestRouter.java      # all HTTP handler methods and route registration\n  server/\n    HttpSupport.java        # read request bodies, send JSON responses\n  game/\n    Rules.java              # dice, XP, encounter difficulty, ability modifiers, etc.\n  json/\n    JsonParser.java         # minimal recursive-descent JSON parser\n    JsonUtils.java          # JSON serialization and int coercion\n  model/\n    Combatant.java          # initiative combatant\n    CombatSession.java      # persisted encounter\n    Condition.java          # status condition on a combatant\n    User.java               # registered user with salt/hash\n  storage/\n    Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database.\n`Storage` shells out to the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a single `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by `Storage.reset()`.\n\nTables:\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events`, `quests`, `quest_milestones` — campaign state, session log, and quest tracker.\n- `factions`, `npcs` — campaign factions and NPCs with relationship disposition.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled campaign sessions and per-character attendance.\n\n### Routing\n\n`Main` creates an `HttpServer` from `com.sun.net.httpserver`, builds a `RequestRouter`, and calls `router.register(server)` to attach all contexts.\nThe router uses `HttpExchange::getRequestMethod()` and `getRequestURI().getPath()` to dispatch.\n\nHandlers are grouped by domain:\n\n- **Core / dice:** `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`\n- **Character rules:** `/v1/characters/ability-modifier`, `/v1/characters/proficiency`, `/v1/characters/derived-stats`\n- **Combat:** `/v1/combat/sessions` (create), `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance`\n- **Auth:** `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login`\n- **Storage:** `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset`\n- **Compendium:** `/v1/compendium/monsters` (POST), `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}` (GET), `/v1/compendium/items` (POST), `/v1/compendium/items/{slug}` (GET)\n- **Campaigns:** `/v1/campaigns` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/state` (GET), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/characters` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/events` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/factions` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships` (GET), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/{project_id}/advance` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions` (POST), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/next` (GET), `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/{session_id}/attendance` (POST)\n- **PHB rules:** `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load`\n- **DM tools:** `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap`\n\nMost handlers validate the request body, throw `RuntimeException` on bad input, and translate any exception into a `400` response. Missing resources return `404`. Conflicts return `409`.\n\n### JSON handling\n\nRequests and responses are JSON. The built-in `JsonParser` and `JsonUtils` are intentionally minimal and preserve the exact output format expected by the test suite:\n\n- Field order is determined by `LinkedHashMap` insertion order.\n- Numbers without a fractional part are serialized as integers.\n- Only standard escape sequences are supported.\n\nIf you change serialization, ensure the test suite output format stays identical.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Initiative and combat\n\n- `POST /v1/initiative/order` — sorts combatants by `roll + dex`, breaking ties by dex then name.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions` — creates a persisted combat session with a sorted order and returns the first active combatant.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions` — adds a timed condition to a combatant in the session.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance` — advances the turn tracker, increments the round on wrap, and decrements/removes conditions on the newly active combatant.\n\n### Encounter math\n\n- `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp` — calculates base XP, multiplier, adjusted XP, and difficulty thresholds for a party.\n- `POST /v1/dm/encounter-builder` — looks up monster slugs from the compendium and delegates to the same encounter math.\n\n### Compendium and campaigns\n\n- Monsters and items are created by slug and read back by slug.\n- Campaigns own characters and a chronological event log.\n- `POST /v1/dm/session-recap` reads the latest campaign event and derives an open-thread hook from its summary.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/factions` creates a campaign faction.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/npcs` creates a campaign NPC linked to a faction.\n- `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/relationships` returns faction and NPC counts, including `friendly_npcs` (NPCs with `disposition > 0`).\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting` creates a downtime crafting project for a character (returns `days_completed: 0` and `status: active`).\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/{project_id}/advance` advances a project by `days`; when `days_completed` reaches `days_required` the project becomes `complete` and the crafted item is added to the campaign inventory with owner `party`.\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions` schedules a session with an agenda and returns the session id, start time, duration, and `agenda_count`.\n- `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/next` returns the earliest scheduled session (`id`, `starts_at`, `agenda_count`).\n- `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/{session_id}/attendance` records present and absent    if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            storage.reset();\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"ok\", true);\n            res.put(\"schema_version\", 1);\n HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            String expression = (String) req.get(\"expression\");\n            if (expression == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing expression\");\n            Matcher matcher = DICE_PATTERN.matcher(expression.trim());\n            if (!matcher.matches()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"roll\"));\n            int modifier = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"modifier\"));\n            int dc = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"dc\"));\n            int total = roll + modifier;\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"total\", total);\n            res.put(\"success\", total >= dc);\n            res.put(\"margin\", total - dc);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAdjustedXp(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) res.put(\"base_xp\", calc.get(\"base_xp\"));\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", calc.get(\"monster_count\"));\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", calc.get(\"multiplier\"));\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", calc.get(\"adjusted_xp\"));\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", calc.get(\"difficulty\"));\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", calc.get(\"thresholds\"));\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> combatantsList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"combatants\");\n            if (combatantsList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Object combatantObj : combatantsList) {\n                Map<String, Object> combatant = (Map<String, Object>) combatantObj;\n                String name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                int dex = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"dex\"));\n                int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"roll\"));\n                int score = roll + dex;\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer) b.get(\"score\");\n                if (scoreB != scoreA) return scoreB - scoreA;\n                int dexA = (Integer) a.get(\"_dex\");\n                int dexB = (Integer) b.get(\"_dex\");\n                if (dexB != dexA) return dexB - dexA;\n                String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return nameA.compareTo(nameB);\n            });\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> combatant : combatants) {\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", combatant.get(\"name\"));\n                out.put(\"score\", combatant.get(\"score\"));\n                order.add(out);\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityModifier(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            int level = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"level\"));\n            if (level < 1 || level > 20) throw new RuntimeException(\"Level out of range\");\n\n            Map<String, Object> abilities = (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"abilities\");\n            if (abilities == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing abilities\");\n            String[] abilityNames = {\"str\", \"dex\", \"con\", \"int\", \"wis\", \"cha\"};\n\n            Map<String, Integer> modifiers = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (String name : abilityNames) {\n                Object val = abilities.get(name);\n                if (val == null) throw new (Map<String, Object>) req.get(\"armor\");\n            if (armor == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing armor\");\n            int base = JsonUtils.toInt(armor.get(\"base\"));\n            int dexCap = JsonUtils.toInt(armor.get(\"dex_cap\"));\n            boolean shield = Boolean.TRUE.equals(armor.get(\"shield\"));\n            int shieldBonus = shield ? 2 : 0;\n            int armorClass = base + Math.min(modifiers.get(\"dex\"), dexCap) + shieldBonus;\n\n            int hpMax = level * (6 + modifiers.get(\"con\"));\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"level\", level);\n            res.put(\"proficiency_bonus\", Rules.proficiencyBonus(level));\n            res.put(\"hp_max\", hpMax);\n            res.put(\"armor_class\", armorClass);\n            res.put(\"modifiers\", modifiers);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleCombatSessionCreate(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            String id = (String) req.get(\"id\");\n || combatantsList.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n            if (storage.getCombatSession(id) != null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Duplicate session id\");\n\n            List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Object combatantObj : combatantsList) {\n                Map<String, Object> combatant = (Map<String, Object>) combatantObj;\n                String name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatant name\");\n                int dex = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"dex\"));\n                int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"roll\"));\n                int score = roll + dex;\n                combatants.add(new Combatant(name, score, dex, roll));\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                if (b.score != a.score) return b.score - a.score;\n                if (b.dex != a.dex) return b.dex - a.dex;\n                return a.name.compareTo(b.name);\n            });\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession(id, combatants);\n            if (!storage.insertCombatSession(session)) throw new RuntimeException(\"Duplicate session id\");\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"id\", id);\n            res.put(\"round\", 1);\n            res.put(\"turn_index\", 0);\n            res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(combatants.get(0)));\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Combatant c : combatants) order.add(combatantJson(c));\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/combat/sessions/\";\n        if (!path.startsWith(prefix)) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String rest = path.substring(prefix.length());\n        int slash = rest.indexOf('/');\n        if (slash < 0) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n        if (session == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Session not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n                String target = (String) req.get(\"target\");\n                String condition = (String) req.get(\"condition\");\n                int durationRounds = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"duration_rounds\"));\n                if (target == null || condition == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n                if (durationRounds <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (!found) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unknown target\");\n\n                storage.addCondition(id, target, condition, durationRounds);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                List<Map<String, Object>> conditions = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Condition cond : session.conditions.get(target)) {\n                    Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                    condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                    conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active = session.order.get(session.turnIndex);\n\n                storage.advanceCombatSession(session, active);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"id\", session.id);\n                res.put(\"round\", session.round);\n                res.put(\"turn_index\", session.turnIndex);\n                res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                for (Map.Entry<String, List<Condition>> entry : session.conditions.entrySet()) {\n                    List<Map<String, Object>> condList = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Condition cond : entry.getValue()) {\n                        Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                        condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                        condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                        condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n                    conditions.put(entry.getKey(), condList);\n                }\n                if (!conditions.containsKey(active.name)) {\n                    conditions.put(active.name, new ArrayList<>());\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else {\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleRegister(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 409, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Username already exists\\\"}\");\n                return;\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"username\", username);\n            res.put(\"role\", role);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 201, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleLogin(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            String username = expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> combatantsList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"combatants\");\n            if (combatantsList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Object combatantObj : combatantsList) {\n                Map<String, Object> combatant = (Map<String, Object>) combatantObj;\n                String name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                int dex = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"dex\"));\n                int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"roll\"));\n                int score = roll + dex;\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer) b.get(\"score\");\n                if (scoreB != scoreA)      String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return nameA.compareTo(nameB);\n            });\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> combatant : combatants) {\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", combatant.get(\"name\"));\n                out.put(\"score\", combatant.get(\"score\"));\n                order.add(out);\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityModifier(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/combat/sessions/\";\n     return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n        if (session == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Session not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n                String target = (String) req.get(\"target\");\n                String condition = (String) req.get(\"condition\");\n                int durationRounds = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"duration_rounds\"));\n                if (target == null || condition == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n                if (durationRounds <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (!found) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unknown target\");\n\n                storage.addCondition(id, target, condition, durationRounds);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                List<Map<String, Object>> conditions = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Condition cond : session.conditions.get(target)) {\n                    Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                    condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                    conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active = session.order.get(session.turnIndex);\n\n                storage.advanceCombatSession(session, active);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"id\", session.id);\n                res.put(\"round\", session.round);\n                res.put(\"turn_index\", session.turnIndex);\n                res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                for (Map.Entry<String, List<Condition>> entry : session.conditions.entrySet()) {\n                    List<Map<String, Object>> condList = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Condition cond : entry.getValue()) {\n                        Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                        condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                        condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                        condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n                    conditions.put(entry.getKey(), condList);\n                }\n                if (!conditions.containsKey(active.name)) {\n                    conditions.put(active.name, new ArrayList<>());\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else {\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleRegister(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if
